title: Launch Tower
description: A forty-metre service tower beside the pad, with its arms swung out toward the rocket.

title: Lightning Mast
description: A fifty-metre mast to take the lightning before a rocket does.

title: Assembly Building
description: Where rockets are stacked: a hall fifty metres high, with doors to match.

title: Control Centre
description: Where launches are watched from: a long low building with windows all along its front and dishes on the roof.

title: Propellant Farm
description: Three great spheres of propellant, feeding the pads.

title: Floodlight Tower
description: A twenty-metre tower of lamps, lighting the pads at night.

title: Hangar
description: Room for a few aeroplanes out of the weather, with walls on three sides and open to the apron.

title: Control Tower
description: A cab twenty-four metres up, with windows all round, looking down the runway.

title: Windsock
description: Which way the wind blows, and how hard.

title: Centreline Paint
description: A dash of paint down the middle of the runway.

title: Jetty Section
description: Ten metres of jetty: a deck on piles, with bollards to tie up to.

title: Boathouse
description: A shed for boats, with its big door facing the water.

title: Harbour Crane
description: A crane at the head of the jetty, with its jib out over the berth.

title: Rock Arch
description: A span of rock the sea has worn through, on the edge of the Cape's shelf.
